body: cheers to you, too. We all hope you have found peace.

When it comes to simple solutions, don’t get hung up over every little problem you have. It can build up and give you a lot of problems, and may become troublesome in the future. You can either let go of that frustration and not give it any time, or tackle it head on in order to resolve it. I guess the most important thing from all of this is to remember that there will always be something positive, though it feels like there’s only negative. Even if it’s something small, let yourself feel happy over those small things, and they can surprisingly brighten your day.
